question: Gulabo Sapera, a legendry folk dancer from Kalbeliya tribe, Rajasthan, received Padma Shri in the year ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2016**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Gulabo Sapera, a renowned folk dancer from the Kalbeliya tribe in Rajasthan, was honored with the Padma Shri in 2016.
 
• The Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India, recognizing distinguished contributions in various fields.
 
• Gulabo Sapera is known for popularizing the Kalbeliya dance form internationally.
 
• Kalbeliya dance, associated with the Kalbeliya community, is characterized by its fluid movements and vibrant costumes, often performed to the tunes of traditional Rajasthani music.
 
• The award recognized her efforts in preserving and promoting the rich cultural heritage of Rajasthan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalbeliya Dance**

 
 
• Kalbeliya dance is a traditional dance form performed by the Kalbeliya community, also known as snake charmers, in Rajasthan.
 
• It is known for its serpentine dance movements and vibrant, colorful costumes adorned with mirror work.
 
• The dance form is recognized as an intangible cultural heritage by UNESCO.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards**
 
 
• The Padma Awards are one of the highest civilian honors in India, instituted in 1954.
 
• They are conferred in three categories: Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.
 
• The awards are given in various disciplines such as art, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, literature and education, sports, and civil service.
 
 
 
• **Gulabo Sapera's Contributions**
 
 
• Gulabo Sapera has performed internationally, taking the Kalbeliya dance to global platforms.
 
• She has also worked towards the upliftment of the Kalbeliya community, promoting education and healthcare.
 
• Her life and achievements have inspired many documentaries and books.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage**
 
 
• UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list aims to ensure better protection of important cultural heritages around the world.
 
• The list recognizes traditions or living expressions inherited from our ancestors and passed on to our descendants, such as oral traditions, performing arts, social practices, rituals, festive events, and knowledge and practices concerning nature and the universe.
